name: Kuro no Tsuki Gaiden ~Gen'ya no Sho~
original_name: 蒼黒の月外伝～幻夜の書～
source:
Four years after events of Kuro no Tsuki. 
The slowly regains peace. The towns are revived, and those who lost relatives learn to nurture new love.  
One day Altraud gets a letter saying “I want you to leave my church”. Once again he sets to the Black Kingdom to uncover the mystery... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《黑之月》的事件过去四年后。

世界逐渐恢复和平。城镇重建，失去亲人的人们也开始学会培育新的爱情。
某天，阿尔特劳德收到一封信，上面写着：“请你离开我的教会。”他再次前往黑之王国，揭开其中的谜团……

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-may-2002.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
